entries.question_en: Where does a BHW's duty come from?
entries.question_fil: Saan nanggagaling ang tungkulin ng isang BHW?
entries.answer_en: RA 7883 section 3 connects training programs under an accredited government or nongovernment organization, voluntary community primary health care and accreditation by the local health board under DOH guidelines. Experience or an informal invitation alone is insufficient proof; ask the locally confirmed contact to verify training and accreditation evidence.
entries.answer_fil: Sa seksiyon 3 ng RA 7883, magkaugnay ang pagsasanay sa akreditadong organisasyong pampamahalaan o di-pampamahalaan, boluntaryong primary health care sa komunidad at akreditasyon ng local health board ayon sa gabay ng DOH. Hindi sapat na patunay ang karanasan o paanyaya lamang; itanong sa locally confirmed na contact kung paano matitiyak ang ebidensiya.

entries.question_en: Who is responsible for BHW accreditation, and does training alone prove it?
entries.question_fil: Sino ang may pananagutan sa BHW accreditation, at patunay ba nito ang training lamang?
entries.answer_en: RA 7883 sections 3–4 place accreditation with the local health board under DOH guidelines and distinguish registration and appropriate proof of accreditation. A training certificate alone is not an official board decision or proof of completed accreditation. Confirm the actual local process, responsible contact and official record with the RHU, municipal/city health office or board contact; do not assume status or invent local requirements.
entries.answer_fil: Sa seksiyon 3–4 ng RA 7883, nakaugnay sa local health board ang akreditasyon ayon sa gabay ng DOH, at magkahiwalay ang rehistrasyon at naaangkop na patunay ng akreditasyon. Hindi opisyal na pasya ng board o patunay ng kumpletong akreditasyon ang training certificate lamang. Tiyakin ang aktuwal na lokal na proseso, tamang contact at opisyal na tala sa RHU, municipal/city health office o board contact; huwag ipagpalagay ang status o mag-imbento ng lokal na requirement.

entries.question_en: What benefits can a BHW receive under RA 7883?
entries.question_fil: Anong mga benepisyo ang maaaring matanggap ng isang BHW sa ilalim ng RA 7883?
entries.answer_en: RA7883 sections4–7 cover hazard and subsistence allowances; training, education and career enrichment; civil service eligibility; duty-connected PAO legal services; and preferential loan access for organized BHW groups with health-supporting income-generating projects. Registration where service is rendered is required; section6 covers accredited BHWs actively and regularly performing duties. Hazard exposure needs proper-authority validation, with amount determined by the board and peace and order council. Subsistence concerns service within an isolated BHS for availability at all times and meals during duty, computed by the LGU. Local-fund benefits need board review/approval. Check the specific condition and responsible authority; no automatic identical payment or personal loan is promised.
entries.answer_fil: Saklaw ng seksiyon4–7 ng RA7883 ang hazard at subsistence allowances; training, education at career enrichment; civil service eligibility; PAO legal services para sa kasong kaugnay ng tungkulin; at preferential loan access ng organisadong BHW groups na may income-generating projects na sumusuporta sa kalusugan. Kailangan ang rehistrasyon kung saan naglilingkod; saklaw ng seksiyon6 ang akreditadong BHW na aktibo at regular ang tungkulin. Kailangan ang proper-authority validation ng hazard exposure, at board at peace and order council ang magtatakda ng halaga. Sa subsistence, serbisyo sa loob ng isolated BHS upang available anumang oras at pagkain sa tungkulin ang kaugnay ng computation ng LGU. Kailangan ng board review/approval kapag lokal na pondo. Tiyakin ang kondisyon at tamang awtoridad; walang pangakong awtomatikong pantay na bayad o personal na loan.

entries.question_en: What are the requirements for BHW Eligibility (BHWE) in the Civil Service?
entries.question_fil: Ano ang mga kondisyon para sa BHW Eligibility (BHWE) sa Civil Service?
entries.answer_en: RA 7883 section 6(d) gives the statutory basis; CSC implementing conditions require Local Health Board accreditation, at least two college years leading to a degree, and at least five years of continuous, active, full-time, voluntary and satisfactory service while already accredited. Do not count pre-accreditation service or service before 20 February 1995. Voluntary service excludes salary/compensation except honorarium; CSC clarifies government appointments/plantilla payroll and excludes meal/transport allowances from salary. JO/COS workers may still qualify; a label alone is neither approval nor disqualification. Verify the arrangement, evidence and unclear continuity with CSC. BHWE is appropriate for first-level positions with trade-test/license/stenographer/board-exam/special-law exceptions, not a professional license or appointment guarantee. Ask the CSC office for the barangay of service; Regional Office approval determines effectivity. Confirm current documentary guidance there.
entries.answer_fil: RA 7883 section 6(d) ang statutory basis; hinihingi ng CSC implementing conditions ang Local Health Board accreditation, hindi bababa sa dalawang college years tungo sa degree, at limang taong tuloy-tuloy, aktibo, full-time, voluntary at satisfactory na serbisyo habang accredited na. Hindi counted ang pre-accreditation service o bago 20 Pebrero 1995. Walang salary/compensation maliban sa honorarium sa voluntary service; nililinaw ng CSC ang government appointment/plantilla payroll at hindi kasama sa salary ang meal/transport allowances. Maaaring kwalipikado pa rin ang JO/COS worker; hindi approval o disqualification ang label lamang. Tiyakin sa CSC ang arrangement, ebidensiya at unclear continuity. Para sa naaangkop na first-level positions ang BHWE, may trade-test/license/stenographer/board-exam/special-law exceptions; hindi ito professional license o appointment guarantee. Magtanong sa CSC office na may sakop sa barangay ng serbisyo; Regional Office approval ang batayan ng effectivity. Tiyakin doon ang kasalukuyang documentary guidance.

entries.question_en: What is the local health board responsible for in the accreditation process?
entries.question_fil: Ano ang responsibilidad ng local health board sa proseso ng akreditasyon?
entries.answer_en: The signed DILG–DOH JMC 2023-001 VI.D.1–8 lists board duties: safeguard registration/accreditation; evaluate and act on applications; record decisions in resolutions/minutes; issue certificates to qualified BHWs; review/approve local-fund benefits; recommend benefits/funds; provide registry copies to DOH; and monitor services. The training guide summarizes committee screening, interviews, recommendations and registry assistance. The circular permits and encourages committee creation; if absent/pending, the board still facilitates the process. A committee recommendation is not automatic board approval. Confirm the local arrangement and official decision record. The complete national IRR and amendment history were not retrieved in this audit.
entries.answer_fil: Inililista sa VI.D.1–8 ng nilagdaang DILG–DOH JMC 2023-001 ang tungkulin ng board: pangalagaan ang rehistrasyon/akreditasyon; suriin at aksiyunan ang aplikasyon; itala ang pasya sa resolution/minutes; maglabas ng sertipiko sa kwalipikadong BHW; suriin/aprubahan ang local-fund benefits; magrekomenda ng benepisyo/pondo; magbigay ng registry copies sa DOH; at subaybayan ang serbisyo. Buod sa training guide ang pagsusuri, panayam, rekomendasyon at registry assistance ng komite. Pinahihintulutan at hinihikayat ng circular ang pagbuo ng komite; kapag wala pa o binubuo, pinadadali pa rin ng board ang proseso. Hindi automatic board approval ang rekomendasyon. Tiyakin ang lokal na ayos at opisyal na tala ng pasya. Hindi nakuha sa audit ang buong national IRR at amendment history.

entries.question_en: What should a BHW do if their accreditation or benefit is delayed?
entries.question_fil: Ano ang dapat gawin ng BHW kung naantala ang kanyang akreditasyon o benepisyo?
entries.answer_en: Follow up calmly with a specific question — such as the status of the application and whether anything else needs to be submitted — rather than a vague complaint. A clear, calm question is more likely to be answered, and staying silent about a delay often just lets a fixable problem drag on longer.
entries.answer_fil: Mag-follow-up nang kalmado at may tiyak na tanong — tulad ng status ng aplikasyon at kung may kailangan pang ibigay — sa halip na reklamong walang tiyak na hinihingi. Ang malinaw at kalmadong tanong ay mas malamang na masagot, at ang katahimikan sa harap ng pagkaantala ay madalas nagpapahaba lang ng problemang kaya sanang maayos.
